name: copy-path-with-lines
description: Copies the active file's full path, appending the selected line range when there is a selection.

copyPathWithLines.allowMultipleSelection.markdownDescription: When multiple selections exist (e.g. from multiple cursors), merge the line ranges of all selections into the copied path (e.g. `foo.ts:11-22,34-46`). When disabled, only the primary selection is used.
